calls.video_title: Uranium Hit a 20-Year High. The Stocks That Mine It Crashed 60% (Here's the Real 2027 Plan)
calls.thesis: Cameco (captions garble as 'Kamako/Kamico') realized only ~$65.80/lb in Q3 vs ~$96.50 long-term contract price because its book was signed at lower prices; as those contracts roll off in 2027 it can re-sign at higher prices — 'there will be a rebound if they start realizing these higher prices'.
calls.base_case: Legacy low-price commitments heaviest through 2028, lighter 2029-2030; CEO stressing capital discipline, not chasing volume.
calls.bull_case: Analysts show ~137% upside with targets $90-$150 ('a raging buy from a dozen analysts'); uranium long-term contract price at a record ~$99 (TradeTech, end Oct).
calls.bear_case: Key Lake mill outage forced 2026 production guidance down to 19.5-20.5M lbs; the rebound depends on the mill getting back on track and the realized/long-term price gap closing.
